thread:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the 04/05 model reload incident. Symptom was intermittent model reloads during sustained high batch sizes, causing tail latency spikes. Need owners for remediation, temporary mitigations, and RACI so we can close the PM.

Rina: I'll take ownership of the fix to the model lifecycle manager. Creating INF-4401 as the parent ticket.

Diego: SRE will own a temporary mitigation to reduce batch-size ceiling and add a throttling rule. I'll file INF-4402 for the mitigation. ETA Fri 2026-04-10.

Maya: QE will add a regression test that simulates long-running streams and checks for reload churn. I'll take INF-4403. ETA Mon 2026-04-13.

bot-postmortem: Incident INC-2026-20260405-02 recorded and linked to INF-4401. Notification: #eng-oncall + oncall-sre.

Sam: RACI suggestion: R=Rina (implement), A=Sam (postmortem owner), C=Diego (SRE),C=Maya (QE), I=Product/CS. Thoughts?

Ethan: Agree. Also recommend a short-term config rollback plan in case the change increases memory pressure. I can own the rollback runbook. INF-4404 created.

Rina: Plan: adjust the soft-reload threshold and add a backoff window; land behind FF. Will document perf trade-offs. Linking INF-4401 -> INF-4403 for tests.

Diego: Mitigation is to lower max_batch_tokens from 4096 -> 3072 in the autoscaler policy for 24h and observe. I'll apply to a canary pool.

Maya: QE note: will use load-harness v2 with `--sustained-streams=200 --duration=30m` and validate no reload events in logs. Please tag me when FF is up.

Sam: Checklist I'm putting in-thread:
- Parent INF-4401 created (Rina)
- Short-term mitigation INF-4402 applied (Diego) - canary OK
- Acceptance/regression INF-4403 (Maya) - pending
- Rollback runbook INF-4404 (Ethan) - drafted
- Feature flag + PR for lifecycle change - Rina
- Post-deploy monitoring window 48h
- Cross-team note to CS & account-exec if customers saw impact

Ethan: Canary applied. No reloads observed in the canary pool after 45m. Pushing notes to INF-4402.

Rina: Opened PR, adding reviewers @Maya @Diego. Code changes are behind `disable-aggressive-reload` FF.

Maya: Will run regression after PR merge. If green, we'll sign off on INF-4401.

Diego: Also adding a Grafana panel to track `model_reloads_total` and `reload_duration_ms` so we have clearer post-mortem metrics.

Sam: Scheduling closure sync Thurs 2026-04-16 09:00 PT. Please upload test artifacts and canary logs to the parent ticket before the meeting.

Rina: Added implementation notes and a short risk matrix to INF-4401.

Maya: Regression run passed on staging. Pushing logs and summary to INF-4403.

Ethan: Rollback runbook reviewed by SRE. Marking INF-4404 as ready.

Sam: Good progress. Long-term action: run quarterly analysis on reload patterns across tenants and consider adaptive throttling. Can someone pick that exploratory item?

Diego: I'll add INF-4410 for exploratory analysis and propose metrics next sprint.

Sam: Thanks everyone 64f. We'll aim to close the parent after the 48h monitoring window completes.
